about_the_game:
✨ Features:

[*] Unlock 100+ Waifus with unique personalities, stories & barks

[*] Collect, click, and craft Eggs to hatch rare Waifus

[*] Trade & sell Waifus on the Steam Community Market

[*] Unlock full storylines and gallery pics

[*] Lightweight idle design — runs minimized

[*] Deeper updates coming every few weeks

🍵 Let’s get cozy

Love comes to those who click in this comfy, chaotic casual idler. Get a random new waifu every 3 hours — or even sooner if you tap fast and use the right strategy. Some waifus are ultra-rare. Some are… legendary.

💘 Build your dream collection

Each waifu has her own personality, dialogue, and now — a full story you can unlock as you bond.

Meet tsunderes, yanderes, dommy mommies, goth gfs, bunnygirls, weirdos, hackers, artists, witches, dreamwalkers, disaster lesbians, and more.

New waifus and features are added with every update. Whether you’re a casual collector or a long-term simp strategist, there’s always someone new to fall for.

🥚 Crafting, Clicking, Candies & More

Not just luck — you can now collect shards and craft Eggs to hatch your favorite waifus.

Tap to build affection, reduce cooldowns, and earn higher-tier drops. The deeper your account level, the better your chances at scoring rares.

And yes — candies are still here. But they’ve been… rebalanced. 🍬

📖 Storylines & Secrets

Each waifu now has a full storyline you can unlock right in their gallery.

Learn their pasts, obsessions, heartbreaks, philosophies, and maybe… what they think about you. 😳

Some are funny. Some are spicy. Some are deeply unwell. You’ll love them all.

💸 The Waifu Economy

Every waifu is a real collectible that can be sold or traded on the Steam Community Market — no fees, no catches.

With a loot system designed by an actual economist (no, really), Waifu Simulator makes collecting feel both rewarding and chaotic.

Ultra-rares and limited editions offer exclusive cosmetics and future bonuses. Gacha with purpose. 🧠

🌸 Runs on a potato

Waifu Simulator runs on just about anything. Minimize it, let it idle in the background, or go full speedclicker — it won’t complain.

👀 And this is just the beginning...

Waifu may look simple, but there’s so much more to come:

[*] Expanding dialogue systems and more interactions

[*] Crafting systems and gift mechanics

[*] Extra unlocks, including “special” pics 😘

[*] Long-term goals like marriage, eternal love… or heartbreak

[*] Waifus you’ll never forget (even if you try)

~ I can’t wait to meet you, anon ~

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: General Mature Content

  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • Processor: GTX 460 or Radeon HD 6770
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
